content: MK notes that Kirmānī tells the Nile episode (Akhlāṭī's alchemical show of the river turned to blood, hands and feet, milk) without Niʿmat Allāh's four companions or the sealed box of cotton and flame that Ṣunʿ Allāh has; he reads both as one hagiographic strategy, first to establish Akhlāṭī's mastery of the occult sciences and then to show Niʿmat Allāh greater still.
refers_to_primary: Two Niʿmatullahi accounts of the Nile episode
